task: Mapping v2: a VNC lineage tier from the Allen et al. 2020 VNC atlas; H1 v2; post hoc sensitivity of H1 v1 and of the AD-FCA contrasts
declared: 2026-10-22, after H1 v1 (null) and T-SC4b were known and before any VNC atlas file was downloaded

data.geo: GSE141807_RAW.tar (70,584,320 bytes): GSM4213596-9 female_rep1/2, male_rep1/2 *_dge.txt.gz (genes x cells)
elife: elife-54074-fig1-data1-v1.xlsx (459,067 bytes): marker genes of the 120 clusters
elife-54074-fig1-data2-v1.xlsx (17,114 bytes): cluster summary with the predicted hemilineage and transmitter
data.approval: each file needs the user's approval; receipts in data/external/receipt.csv

bridge.qc: cells with 300-6,000 detected genes and a mitochondrial UMI fraction (genes mt:*) <= 0.10
bridge.normalisation: log1p(counts per 10,000); per-gene z-scores over the cells kept
bridge.markers: per published cluster: genes with positive average log fold change and adjusted p < 0.05 in Figure 1-source data 1, the 25 largest by log fold change (fewer if fewer)
bridge.assignment: score(cell, cluster) = mean z of the cluster's markers; the cell takes the best cluster when the best score is >= 0.25 and exceeds the second best by >= 0.25, else it stays unassigned
bridge.hemilineage: the cluster's predicted hemilineage in Figure 1-source data 2; clusters without a designation, with an ambiguous one (two or more hemilineages, "?" or "or") or not neuronal are left out
bridge.unit: per hemilineage, every assigned cell of its clusters over the four replicates (>= 30 cells): mean log1p(cp10k) and detection fraction
bridge.malecns: trumanHl normalised by stripping leading zeros (06B -> 6B); a composite label (e.g. 20A.22A) takes the pooled cells of its components when all are present; TBD is unmapped
bridge.tier: lineage, between fuzzy and class (exact > alias > fuzzy > lineage > class); source allen2020vnc

gates.V1: recovered cell counts per published cluster vs the published counts: Spearman rho >= 0.7
gates.V2: dominant fast transmitter of each bridged hemilineage (VAChT/ChAT vs Gad1/VGAT vs VGlut, each relative to its highest hemilineage) equals the majority EM transmitter of the MaleCNS cells with that trumanHl in >= 80% of the bridged hemilineages with a known transmitter
gates.V3: each hemilineage's markers in Figure 4-source data 1 have a mean z > 0 in its assigned cells in >= 80% of the hemilineages listed there
gates.V4: descriptive: assigned cells per hemilineage vs MaleCNS cells per trumanHl (Spearman rho)
gates.rule: the lineage tier is used only if V1-V3 pass; otherwise the VNC stays unmapped and that is reported

h1_v2.values: as amendment 0005, with the lineage units as a further source (z over its bridged hemilineages)
h1_v2.level: type + lineage (exact, alias, fuzzy, lineage); if fewer than 50% of the M0 carriers map there (Gate SC-A), the tests run at any tier (adding class) and are labelled with their coverage
tests: A, label null within superclass (as F14.SC.trace test 1)
A, mapping null: values permuted across the mapped units (types; hemilineages for lineage-tier cells) within superclass, carriers fixed
h1_v2.alternative: one-sided (greater); p = (1 + #{null >= T}) / (1 + 10,000); numpy default_rng(20261022) per test

families.F14.SC.trace.v2.secondary: M0 joint, S1, S2, 12 tests, BH

h1_v2.central_brain: a central-brain lineage tier (Allen et al. 2026 hemilineage annotations, not public as files) would need its own amendment before use

tests: M0, label null within superclass x source strata, class level
the same at type + fuzzy level
M0, cells whose best unit is from Davis 2020 only (one bulk source), label null within superclass, type + fuzzy level
sensitivity_v1.why: source-specific scaling of the z-scores could confound the v1 comparison when carriers and other cells of a superclass map through different sources

adfca_full.model: all 14 libraries in one OLS: y ~ 1 + genotype (control, AB42, hTau) + age (10, 20, 30 as factors) + sex; two-sided t-tests of the AB42 and hTau coefficients (8 df); genotype effects assumed constant across ages
adfca_full.units: CNS-neuron units with >= 20 cells in every library (34) and the pan-neuronal unit
adfca_full.outcomes: Shal and the adaptation index, as F14.SC.adfca
